name: NIPUN Bharat Mission - Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this mission, all children can get admission in Class 1 as per the admission norms of all schools in the state.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All children aged 3 to 9 years are eligible to benefit from the scheme to achieve foundational literacy and numeracy.
